name: Busy parent: hours, dozen cupcakes, lead time
description: Tests that facts match the site and that the missing lead time is admitted, not invented.
instruction: Ask for the bakery's hours, the price of a dozen cupcakes and how far ahead to order. If the lead time answer is vague, ask once more for a number of days.
conditions: The site has no lead time on any page.
stop_rules: Stop once all three questions have an answer or a clear 'not on the website'.
